svg.title: The life-crm framework, as an architecture diagram
svg.desc: Public internet: an optional public page. Private, behind a Cloudflare login: you; a chat assistant on WhatsApp or Telegram; a dashboard on Cloudflare; one Google Sheet in Google Drive; your sources; an AI agent; and its workspace on GitHub. Arrows show who reads, writes, builds and publishes.
